_note: Game id -> Steam API name (remapped to rc8a 754606d, Oct 20 2026). Create each API name in Steamworks > Stats & Achievements (Blake). ACH/RIB tables unchanged from rc7/rc7.1 (33 + 6). rc8.2 #7 (Oct 28): +ACH_HUEY_UNLOCK (game id is already the API name); unmapped ids are dropped, not guessed. rc8.2 EP Oct 28: ribbon achievements (ACH_RIB_*) dropped - real medals are never rewards.

squad2._note: Achievement -> Doc LOADOUT unlocks only (rc8a P3.LO, unchanged from rc7: kit=first_out, point=hold_10, gun=all_home, m79=lco_hiscore>=8000; selectable the moment its ach/score is earned; demo never). Marine achievements are NOT triggered by conditions or by P3.MREQ (that table is display-only); see squad2_marines.

cloud._note: rc8a has NO 'lco_save_v2' localStorage key. rc8a renamed every lbo2_* key to lco_* (in-game one-time copy lbo2_* -> lco_*, marker lco_migrated; demo keys lbo2demo_ -> lcodemo_). The wrapper keeps the lco_save_v2.json file approach and now syncs lco_* keys. Legacy lbo2_* keys in an older (rc7/rc7.1 wrapper) lco_save_v2.json are restored under their lco_* names by preload.js.
cloud._excludeWhy: lco_crumb/lco_clean = per-session crash forensics; lco_migrated = per-machine migration marker (lets each machine run its own lbo2_->lco_ copy); lco_lowfx = per-device graphics auto-detect (Deck vs desktop). lco_quality = per-device graphics quality (rc8b key; not in rc8a, harmless).

squad2_marines._note: rc8a squad2Check() (index.html ~l.5475) emits window.steamworks.achievement.activate('squad2_unlock_<id>') once per Marine, ONLY when chOpen(id) is true and not DEMO/?all/unlockall; it records the event in localStorage lco_sq2 {id:time}. These fire ONLY on that event (or on re-sync from the saved lco_sq2 record of that same event, so an unlock while Steam was offline is not lost). Unknown squad2_unlock_* ids are ignored. rc8a public build: DOC_ONLY (doconly!=0) -> chOpen() is Doc-only, so in the shipped Electron build no Marine event ever fires. With ?doconly=0, all 8 open together when lco_open='1' (set by Doc's first non-demo evac).
